prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: layered cutout character artwork for a smooth 2D skeletal animation.
Image 1 is the EXACT character and art reference to preserve. Prepare reusable painted body parts of this very same charming cartoon woman. Keep the precise warm cartoon/pixel-hybrid style, brown stepped pixel outlines, dark-brown messy bun, appealing simple large Japanese-animation eye, small smiling nose/mouth, warm skin, cream loose short-sleeved shirt, sage-green loose cuffed trousers and bare feet. Preserve her age, face identity, colors and proportions. Do not redesign her or make her realistic.

Output ONE transparent 1536x1024 production image with TWELVE cleanly separated pieces in a strict FOUR-column THREE-row layout. Each nominal cell is 384x341. Leave at least 30 transparent pixels around each piece. No labels, numbers, guides, shadows, backgrounds or full assembled figures. All pieces upright in their neutral orientation and entirely detached, individually usable as animation layers. No neighboring piece may touch or overlap another.

Row 1, left to right:
1. Her complete right-facing SIDE-PROFILE head, including the entire bun, hair wisps, ear, face and short neck. Copy the selected reference's face closely. Neck points straight downward, head upright. No torso.
2. Her cream shirt TORSO only, front neckline and shoulder armholes at top, loose shirt hem at bottom. Side-profile facing right. No head, arms, hands or legs. Leave the shoulder attachments clean so separate sleeves can overlap.
3. ONE straight upper arm pointing downward, from shoulder through the same cream short sleeve to a rounded bare elbow. No forearm or hand. Sleeve belongs to this layer and must cover its shoulder joint.
4. ONE straight bare forearm pointing downward, rounded elbow at top, slim wrist at bottom. No upper arm or hand.

Row 2, left to right:
5. ONE slender upright prayer/reaching hand, fingers together pointing UP, short wrist stump at bottom. Clean side-profile fingers, same skin and scale.
6. ONE hand resting flat on the floor, short wrist at LEFT, fingers pointing RIGHT, readable relaxed palm profile.
7. ONE baggy sage-green trouser upper-leg piece pointing DOWN, rounded hip at top, knee at bottom. Same cloth folds and colors. No torso, lower leg or foot.
8. ONE sage-green trouser lower-leg piece pointing DOWN, knee at top, gathered cuff and a little bare ankle at bottom. No upper leg or foot.

Row 3, left to right:
9. ONE bare standing foot in right-facing side profile, short ankle above the heel at LEFT, toes pointing RIGHT, flat sole. No leg.
10. ONE bare foot with toes tucked for plank, right-facing side profile, ankle above the heel at LEFT, toe pads at RIGHT, clean relaxed skin folds. No leg.
11. A small sage-green HIP / PELVIS clothing piece, loose trouser waistband and rounded seat in side profile, no legs and no shirt. This joins the two upper-leg layers under the shirt hem.
12. ONE bare foot resting on its instep for upward-facing dog, toes gently lengthened to the LEFT, ankle at RIGHT. No leg.

These are anatomical drawing layers, not an animation sequence. All skin pieces must match exactly; all cloth pieces must match exactly. Use round overlap areas at elbows, knees, shoulder and hip, with no harsh dark cut-edge across the attachment ends. All parts retain the original painted pixel clusters and colored ink contours; no vector shapes, diagrams, stick figures, generic mannequin, 3D or photographic detail. Truly transparent background.

limbPrompts.name: whole-leg
limbPrompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input Image 1 is the selected cartoon woman's exact character and style; Image 2 is the reusable artwork already made for her rig. Preserve this SAME warm cartoon-pixel hybrid drawing, stepped dark brown outlines, flat cel-shaded warm colors and minimal cloth texture. This is a continuous painted limb to replace visible cut-edge seams in a skeletal animation. No realistic body, 3D, photo, diagram, labels, shadows, mat, scenery or other objects. One completely isolated complete part on a TRUE transparent background, portrait-oriented part centered in a landscape 1536x1024 image with generous margins. Do not cut the part into pieces.
Draw ONE complete relaxed sage-green trouser leg from rounded hip / waistband at top down to gathered ankle cuff and a small bare ankle stump at bottom. The leg is straight, pointing DOWN. A long loose trouser silhouette like the reference, slightly fuller at the upper thigh, flowing continuously through the knee into the lower leg, gathered at the ankle. One leg only, not a pair of pants. Absolutely no foot, torso, shirt or other body part. The knee is in the middle, but NO horizontal seam, cut line, separate knee cap, patch, circular joint, mechanical ring or disconnected section anywhere. Continuous simple dark outlines and long coherent cloth folds. The straight leg from hip to ankle is about four times its widest width. Keep the upper opening a softly rounded overlap zone without a hard dark cut edge.

replacementParts.name: torso-clean
replacementParts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this isolated cream shirt torso artwork for the same cartoon/pixel woman. Preserve the existing stepped dark-brown ink outline, cream fabric, warm cel shadows, loose curved waist and split hem, right-facing profile torso, neckline and overall proportions. REMOVE the entire dangling short sleeve visible on the LEFT, including its dark sleeve cuff opening and sleeve outline. This must be a TORSO ONLY with a smooth simple sleeveless shoulder/armhole silhouette: no sleeves, arms, hands, neck, head or other body parts. A separate animated arm layer will supply the actual sleeve. Fill the former sleeve region with a coherent cream torso shape, preserving the original shirt shading style. Do not create another sleeve, add shoulder protrusions, or redesign the character. One isolated complete cream shirt torso centered, upright on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no shadows, guides, text, scenery or other pieces. Keep loose shirt hem and length matching the supplied torso.

limitations: Reuses painted cutout layers; cloth and joints still need artistic refinement.
Head and torso artwork stay rigid instead of being redrawn for every viewing angle.
Separate hand and foot drawings show genuine pose changes; bone lengths and each layer's paint scale stay fixed.
